critique.evidence: Measured performance is demo-ready across all three viewports: LCP is 308–1288 ms, FCP 52–72 ms, load 129–154 ms, TTFB 1.5–7.5 ms, and CLS ranges from 0 to 0.0478. No console, page, or request failures occurred; document width matches viewport at desktop, tablet, and mobile. Animation sampling reports no long frames, with 16.67 ms averages on tablet/mobile and a 33.4 ms worst frame on desktop. The main limitation is payload weight: 1.314 MB transferred, including 1.149 MB of JavaScript, for 17 requests.
critique.fix: Reduce the 1.149 MB JavaScript payload through route-level code splitting, tree-shaking, and deferred loading of non-injection screens; then investigate the tablet’s 0.0478 CLS and desktop’s 19.3 ms average frame time to approach a top score.
